mike_p: FYI — AcmeEdge (HW partner) sent a sample usage payload and asked to go-live next week. Current delivery is hourly CSV drops to a partner S3 bucket. We prefer real-time webhooks. Need to agree on a contract: schema, timestamp semantics, signature verification, timezone handling, idempotency, and a minimal smoke-test matrix. Do we accept CSV for initial go-live or require webhook?

sara_pm: I think we can accept CSV for an initial pilot but only with a strict schema + signed manifest. Proposal: allow CSV for 2-week pilot in shadow mode (no billing), after which we require webhook delivery for production. Also need a test harness and sample data sets (missing rows, duplicate rows, timezone edgecases).

raj_eng: CSV is fine for pilot. Engineering constraints: we need predictable file names and a manifest file so ingestion can be idempotent. Required fields (per-row): partner_id, sku_id, usage_timestamp_utc, usage_seconds (or epoch), quantity, unit, file_row_id. Prefer epoch seconds in UTC. Example CSV row: 

partner_id,sku_id,usage_epoch_secs,quantity,unit,file_row_id
ACME123,HW-EDGE-XL,1713302400,12,requests,row-00001

Also require an HMAC-SHA256 header on the manifest. Quick verification snippet: 

# verify signature (example)
signature=$(echo -n "$payload" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$PARTNER_SECRET" -binary | base64)
curl -H "X-Partner-Signature: $signature" https://ingest.redwood.ai/partner/verify

If they don't provide file_row_id use deterministic hash of row contents for idempotency.

jess_ops: For billing mapping: Acme sends seat_count for some SKUs and per-device counters for others. We need a mapping table: sku_id -> billing_dimension (seats | device-minutes | requests). If seat_count is missing for seat-based SKUs we should mark usage as UNKNOWN and route to manual reconciliation (don't auto-bill). Also define proration rules when their hourly windows overlap billing boundaries. Who owns the mapping table?

anna_legal: Two legal items: 1) retention — contract must state raw usage + signed manifests retained for 12 months accessible for audits, logs for 3 years. 2) PII — ensure payloads do NOT include customer emails or full identifiers; if they must, they must be hashed/pseudonymized. Add SOW clause for data proofs and audit rights.

mike_p: Okay owners: Raj owns ingestion spec + manifest format, Sara owns acceptance criteria and test cases, Jess owns billing mapping and reconciliation playbook, Anna will draft SOW language for retention & data handling. Action items:
- raj_eng: spec + example files (including a broken/duplicate set) by EOD today (1713339999 + 6h).
- sara_pm: test matrix + smoke-test harness outline by tomorrow.
- jess_ops: mapping doc + reconciliation steps (manual workaround) by day after tomorrow.
- anna_legal: SOW redline w/ retention & PII clause by EOW.

sara_pm: :thumbsup: I'll add the test cases (duplicate rows, late-arrival + out-of-order timestamps, DST edgecases, zero-usage rows). Also add a CSV->webhook conversion script so partners can validate locally.

raj_eng: :eyes: will include manifest schema (manifest.json with file list + hmac header), expected failure modes, and monitoring signals (missing manifest, invalid signature, parse errors). For monitoring we want: ingestion-latency, failed-parses-per-hour, duplicates-detected-per-hour.

jess_ops: +1 on manual flagging for UNKNOWN seat_count. Also propose a nightly reconciliation job that backfills any UNKNOWN to a staging bucket for ops review before raising invoices.

deploy-bot: scheduled: partner-ingest-smoke-tests -> tomorrow 09:00 PST (runs against staging).

mike_p: Great. Can folks confirm they can meet the deadlines? If yes I'll schedule a short 30m signoff call Thurs 10am to finalize go/no-go and update the partner. :white_check_mark:

sara_pm: I'll be there.

raj_eng: Confirmed.

jess_ops: Confirmed.

anna_legal: Confirmed (will send initial redline).

mike_p: Thanks — I'll DM AcmeEdge to delay go-live until we complete pilot smoke tests.
